title: Closure under racing verifiers
statement: A verifier model $E$ is closed under racing if, for every pair of Boolean-output verifiers $M_1,M_2$ and natural numbers $a,k$, whenever the Boolean verifiers associated with $M_1$ and $M_2$ are efficient in $E$, the race verifier using $M_1,M_2$ and the length function $n\mapsto a(n+1)^k$ is also efficient in $E$.
hypotheses_covered: the Boolean verifiers associated with $M_1$ and $M_2$ are efficient in $E$
